description: Replace proximity-sphere node picking with precise raycast against glb model geometry (AABB minimum, MeshRayCast stretch); walk glTF scene children like gimbal_center; keep path-point marker picking unregressed
wave_rationale: FR-1/FR-2 (AABB raycast + child-walk) can be prototyped standalone against the existing viewport_pick.rs call site, but final FR-3 integration as a NodePick-priority router consumer depends on input_router_20260713 landing first, so this track is sequenced after that dependency rather than in the parallel wave-0 green set.
notes: User's 'object detection' request == precise mesh/AABB raycast picking of glb models, not proximity. Mirrors fe-ui/src/gimbal.rs gimbal_center's entity-then-children Aabb scan. FR-4 keeps path_point_interaction.rs pick_marker's sphere test intact (markers are small fixed gizmos; proximity is correct there) — only model picking gets precision upgrade. bevy_picking + mesh_picking features already enabled in root Cargo.toml, so MeshRayCast is plausibly available; verify exact import path before relying on it, AABB is the required fallback.
